_notes: Climate design data for load calc + air-density correction.
Sources: ASHRAE Climate Data Center 2021, CIBSE Guide A 2015.
Cooling design = 0.4% / 1% / 2% annual exceedance dry-bulb (DB)
with coincident wet-bulb (MCWB).
Heating design = 99.6% / 99% annual exceedance DB.
HDD / CDD are 18 °C / 10 °C base respectively (CIBSE convention).
Project override at <project>/_BIM_COORD/climate_data.json adds custom sites.
v1.1 additions (Phase 187g):
utcOffsetHours        - site standard-time offset from UTC
observesDstInSummer   - true when DST is in effect on the cooling
design day (typically July in N-hemisphere
-> DST=true for N-hemi DST observers; S-hemi
observers are in their winter on July -> false).
BlockLoadEngine adds these to convert local-clock 'hour' to solar
time so the solar-noon hour aligns with the actual sun position.
Design wind (infiltration only): per-site heatingWindMs / coolingWindMs, m/s, = mean coincident
wind speed at the 10 m met station: heating = 'MCWS to 99.6% DB', cooling = 'MCWS to 0.4% DB'
(ASHRAE Fundamentals Ch. 14 climatic design conditions). NEVER a structural design wind
(BS EN 1991-1-4 vb,0). Absent: 4.0 m/s is assumed and reported (DesignWind.cs).
Every site's values come from the climate.onebuilding.org redistribution of the 2025 ASHRAE
Handbook design conditions (TMYx 2009-2023 .stat, cross-checked against the .ddy), recorded per
site in windSource (station, WMO, edition, period, URL) with a verify note: they have not been
checked against the printed handbook. The wind is from the 2025 edition while the temperatures
above are labelled ASHRAE 2021, so the wind is coincident with the 2025 99.6% / 0.4% DB, which
can differ from heating996DbC / cooling996DbC here. The legacy key designWindMs is still read.
